correctionMatrix.change: boundary binds the trusted PR head branch to the task's declared TASK_STATE.branch (from the head blob) and the root task id to the declared taskId; base must be main.

correctionMatrix.change: FACTORY_GOVERNANCE restricts writes to implementation paths plus the current task's single result dir (from lineage); FROZEN_FACTORY_PREFIXES are immutable; the factory workflow may not be deleted or renamed.

correctionMatrix.name: exact initial skeleton
correctionMatrix.change: stage.mjs creation branch requires the changed additions to equal canonicalSkeletonFiles() exactly (all additions, head PREPARED); extra/missing files fail.

correctionMatrix.name: exact per-stage inventory + duplicate markers
correctionMatrix.change: stage.mjs allows only the exact governed files per transition; markers.mjs requires exactly one candidate per stage (>1 conflicting -> reject).

correctionMatrix.name: marker outcome enums + merge lineage
correctionMatrix.change: markers.mjs enforces controlled review/correction/validation outcome enums; the merge marker requires exact taskId, targetBranch main, 40-hex mergeCommit, recognized mergedState and preceding-receipt linkage.

correctionMatrix.name: cumulative correction from history
correctionMatrix.change: evidence.mjs adds the correction marker to the required cumulative set whenever TASK_STATE.history used CORRECTION_REQUIRED/CORRECTED and the state is VALIDATED or higher.

correctionMatrix.name: history integrity + append-only
correctionMatrix.change: schema.mjs validateHistory (non-empty ordered objects, first PREPARED, last==state, canonical transitions, monotonic timestamps); boundary compares base/head history blobs so prior entries are append-only (checkHistoryAppendOnly).

correctionMatrix.name: strict Git name-status grammar
correctionMatrix.change: boundary.mjs bounds R/C scores to 0-100, rejects quoted/escaped tab-form paths, and adds parseNameStatusZ; the workflow feeds `git -c core.quotePath=false diff -z`.

correctionMatrix.name: non-vacuous package minima
correctionMatrix.change: package.mjs requires overallFinding.recommendation (non-empty string), review.sourceIds (array) and non-empty boolean readiness.*Ready; empty {} objects rejected.

correctionMatrix.name: canonical-text control-byte rejection
correctionMatrix.change: util.mjs hasForbiddenControls rejects NUL, C0 (except LF/TAB), DEL and C1 control code points; wired into package encoding and marker validation.

remainingLimitations: Worktree resolution and CLI stage/history derivation rely on the `git` binary (already required by SCM/CI); absent git, those paths fail closed.

Stage transitions, history append-only and research head<->plan binding are enforced in CI where trusted base/head SHAs and blobs are provided; a local `validate` without SHAs still enforces single-root/frozen/skeleton/marker/package/history-shape rules.
The factory lineage allowlist is an explicit governed constant extended by each authorized task (including the next validation branch); it must be updated as the stack grows.
Research-JSON validation enforces non-vacuous governed top-level minima; deep field-level semantics remain the responsibility of the source-truth review and validation stages.
